entities.name: ON-PREM
entities.rationale: On-premises server stack representing the source environment to be migrated.

entities.name: SLACK
entities.rationale: Slack chatops interface used by the migration team to trigger migration commands.

entities.name: MIGRATION TEAM
entities.rationale: The operations team managing and triggering the migration process.

entities.name: APP DISCOVERY SERVICE
entities.rationale: AWS Application Discovery Service collecting metadata and performance metrics from the on-premises servers.

entities.name: DYNAMODB
entities.rationale: DynamoDB database storing migration metadata, target configurations, and tags.

entities.name: EC2
entities.rationale: The Migration Factory EC2 instance orchestrating the migration workflow.

entities.name: EC2 HOT REPLICA
entities.rationale: Staging EC2 instance receiving continuous block-level replication from the on-premises server.

entities.name: CLOUDENDURE
entities.rationale: CloudEndure migration service performing continuous volume replication.

entities.name: EC2 TARGET
entities.rationale: The final launched EC2 instance in the target account.

visual_connections.description: Migration team issues commands via Slack.
Migration team populates DynamoDB with target metadata and tags.
Slack triggers the migration factory EC2 instance.
Application Discovery Service agent collects metadata from on-premises servers.
Continuous block-level replication from on-premises to the hot replica.
Migration factory queries Application Discovery Service for server metadata.
Migration factory controls CloudEndure replication via API.
CloudEndure manages the hot replica instance.
Migration factory launches and configures the target EC2 instance across accounts.
